purpose: Track first-hand AI, agent, systems, hardware and digital-design methodology without confusing social reach with technical proof.

x.boundary: Read-only after owner login; no follow, like, repost, reply, cookie export or private-session scraping.

reddit.boundary: No account required. r/MachineLearning RSS returned HTTP 200; other feeds may rate-limit and must fail closed. Reddit is discovery-only and claims must be traced upstream.

github.boundary: Repository, release, issue and commit metadata plus pinned source review; popularity does not prove correctness or deployment.

blogs.boundary: Prefer author or organization originals and preserve published/updated dates.
